channel.title: South Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: UAE investor takes South Sudan to arbitration over oil deal
item.description: Aquilon FZCO seeks completion of a March 2025 agreement or compensation for over $300 million in potential losses.

item.title: One killed in clashes near South Sudan-Uganda border
item.description: A 45-year-old South Sudanese refugee travelling to her farm was killed by a stray bullet.

item.title: South Sudanese girl married at 14 for cows
item.description: Nyanbuot, now 17, is a mother of one and pregnant again after her family arranged her marriage in January 2024.

item.title: Five killed in Pochalla cattle raid
item.description: Armed assailants attacked Otallo, killing five civilians and wounding four others, according to local officials.

item.title: Juba City Council digitizes revenue collection
item.description: The council has arrested 32 collectors and launched a new website to improve transparency.
